title: Rust: Pattern Matching with Regex
description: Use and simulate regular expressions for pattern matching and text extraction in Rust.

steps.title: Check if String Contains Pattern
steps.description: Write a function `contains_digit(s: &str) -> bool` that returns true if the string contains any digit (0-9). Test with `"hello123"` and `"hello"`.
hints: `.any()` checks if any character satisfies the predicate.

verification.failureMessage: Print true for 'hello123' and false for 'hello'.

steps.title: Match Email Pattern
steps.description: Write a function `is_valid_email(s: &str) -> bool` that checks if a string looks like an email (contains '@' and '.' after '@'). Test with `"user@example.com"` and `"notanemail"`.
hints: Split by '@', verify the second part contains '.'.
Also check there's text before and after '@'.

verification.failureMessage: Print true for valid email and false for invalid.

steps.title: Extract Phone Numbers
steps.description: Write a function `extract_phone_numbers(text: &str) -> Vec<&str>` that finds patterns like `"(123) 456-7890"` or `"555-1234"`. Test with `"Call (555) 123-4567 or 800-555-0199 for help"`.
hints: Look for patterns: optional area code in parens, then digits.
Extract digit groups: filter for sequences of 3-4 digits with separators.
This simulates regex matching without the regex crate.

verification.failureMessage: Extract and print phone numbers from the text.

steps.title: Replace Patterns
steps.description: Write a function `censor_bad_words(text: &str) -> String` that replaces words like "bad", "terrible", "awful" with "****". Test with `"This is a bad and terrible idea!"`.
hints: Or split by whitespace, check each word, and join.

verification.failureMessage: Censor bad words and print the result.

steps.title: URL Parser
steps.description: Write a function `parse_url(url: &str) -> Option<(String, String, u16, String)>` that extracts protocol, host, port, and path from a URL like `"https://example.com:8080/path/to/page"`.
hints: Split by "://" to get protocol and rest.
Split rest by "/" for host (with port) and path.
Split host by ":" to separate host and port.

verification.failureMessage: Parse and print the URL components.
